prompt: A lone protester in a red bandana and a dark jacket stands in the lower center of a wide city street, seen from behind, facing a towering wall of faceless riot police that fills the far side, their tall shields locked edge to edge and their helmet visors glinting. A thrown red smoke flare arcs over the street between them, trailing a long plume of red smoke that curls up across the frame. Concrete apartment blocks and a giant torn propaganda poster loom on both sides. Woodcut print style with thick carved black ink lines on cream paper, only three flat colors: cream, black ink and bright red, with the smoke and bandana as the only red. Strong graphic silhouettes, and a calm empty band of cream sky across the top quarter.
